body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.75 (naive base rate 0.60) that: Apple announces a new share-repurchase authorization of ≥$100B with its fiscal Q2 2027 results. Evidence: 8-K 30-Apr-2026: dividend raised 4% to $0.27; 'additional program to repurchase up to $100 billion'. Q4 FY26 8-K (2-Nov-2026): $0.27 dividend declared. Annual May authorizations (from memory, partly unverified): 2022 $90B, 2023 $90B, 2024 $110B, 2025 $100B, 2026 $100B. Reasoning: Apple has set ≥$100B for three straight years and still generates >$100B FCF; a cut would signal a capital shift (AI capex/M&A) that we see no evidence for yet. Resolution: YES if Apple's fiscal Q2 2027 earnings release (or another announcement on or before 31-May-2027) authorizes a new/additional repurchase program of ≥$100B. Source: Apple Q2 FY27 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 320193). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

body: Forward test of the flags-judgment context method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.28 (naive base rate 0.32) that: Afcons Infrastructure Q3 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations is ≥₹2,976 cr (no YoY decline vs Q3 FY26). Evidence: NSE pledge data (as of 30-Sep-2026 shareholding): promoters (Shapoorji Pallonji group) hold 50.17%, 53.29% of promoter holding pledged. Q2 FY27 call (5-Nov-2026): company 'revenue' ₹2,906 cr incl. other income (revenue from operations per screener ₹2,635 cr), EBITDA ₹316 cr (10.9%, incl. other income), PAT ₹41 cr; H1 top line −13.6% YoY; 'payments are being stretched' by state agencies, UP Jal Jeevan Mission dues ₹372 cr outstanding, paid only after 75% completion; growth guidance 'held back' due to geopolitical uncertainty; 'Second half would be definitely higher than the first half'; order intake ₹19,437 cr YTD vs FY27 guidance ₹30,000 cr; order book ex-L1 ₹43,836 cr. Screener revenue from operations (₹ cr): Dec-24 3,211, Mar-25 3,223, Jun-25 3,370, Sep-25 2,988, Dec-25 2,976, Mar-26 2,614, Jun-26 2,671, Sep-26 2,635 — three straight YoY declines (−19%, −21%, −12%). Reasoning: Flags-judgment test: the loud flag is the group pledge, but for this specific event we think it is mostly noise; the flag with teeth is customer payment stretch, which management says it will not fund ('we do not want to go overboard in terms of funding any project'). That caps execution. Q3 needs ~+13% QoQ to reach last year's level. Order wins are real but convert to revenue with a lag. We sit a little under the persistence base. Resolution: YES if Afcons Infrastructure's consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026 (results filing; screener.in consolidated 'Sales') is ≥₹2,976 cr. Other income is excluded. Source: Afcons Q3 FY27 results (NSE filing) / screener.in consolidated quarterly table; NSE pledge disclosures. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.
